title: Bulwer-Lytton Fiction Contest — Yearly Winners
description: Archival record of the winners, runners-up, and dishonorable mentions of a single year of the Bulwer-Lytton Fiction Contest. One JSON document represents one contest year.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema so editors can validate the instance.

year.description: The contest year, taken from the page's body content rather than its <title>. NOTE: some archived pages have a mismatched <title> (e.g. the 2010 page is titled '2011 Winners'); prefer the '<year> Grand Prize' heading in the body.

source.description: Provenance of this record, so the archive can be re-derived or audited.

url.description: Canonical live URL the data was captured from, if known.

file.description: Path/filename of the archived HTML this record was extracted from (e.g. 'www_bulwer-lytton_com/2010.html').

pageTitle.description: The raw <title> of the archived page, captured verbatim even when it disagrees with `year` (e.g. '2011 Winners | The Bulwer-Lytton Fiction Contest' on the 2010 page).

retrievedAt.description: Date the archived copy was captured (ISO 8601).

categories.description: Ordered list of award categories as they appear on the page. Grand Prize and other special awards are modeled as categories so every heading is represented uniformly.

misc.description: Catch-all for any extra year-level data that doesn't fit the other fields, stored as a free-form string.

category.description: A single award category (e.g. 'Grand Prize', 'Adventure', 'Dark & Stormy'). Category names change from year to year, so `name` is a free string rather than an enum.

inspiration.description: Optional non-contest passage shown with the category — notably the original Edward Bulwer-Lytton opening line from 'Paul Clifford' displayed under the 'Dark & Stormy' category. This is source material, not a contest entry.

attribution.description: Who/what it is attributed to, e.g. 'Edward Bulwer-Lytton, Paul Clifford'.

entries.description: The contest entries within this category, in display order.

misc.description: Catch-all for any extra category-level data that doesn't fit the other fields, stored as a free-form string.

entry.description: A single contest entry: the submitted sentence plus its author(s) and award designation.

award.description: The entry's designation within its category. Kept as a free string because tiers vary by year; common values are listed in `examples`.

text.description: The verbatim opening sentence submitted, preserving original punctuation, ellipses, and typos.

authors.description: One or more authors credited for the entry (collaborations list more than one).

notes.description: Optional curator note for anything unusual (ambiguous attribution, OCR/parse uncertainty, duplicated author line in source, etc.).

misc.description: Catch-all for any extra entry-level data that doesn't fit the other fields, stored as a free-form string.

name.description: Author's name as credited, e.g. 'Lawrence Person'.

location.description: Location string as credited, typically 'City, ST' (US) or 'City, Country', e.g. 'Austin, TX' or 'Bromma, Sweden'.

region.description: Optional parsed state/province/country portion following the city, e.g. 'TX', 'Sweden'.

misc.description: Catch-all for any extra author-level data that doesn't fit the other fields, stored as a free-form string.
